facts.text: Through the Hawk Flight Book Program, Chowan University provides full-time students with all required textbooks and software access codes for a flat fee of $426 per semester.

sources.title: Hawk Flight Book Program | Chowan University
sources.quote: Full-Time students are charged a one-time per semester program fee of $426 which covers virtually all your required textbooks and computer codes – a savings of approximately 50%.
